decision.rationale: Keep the development result because eligible_for_confirmation is true. Only the static-gate control is eligible; the host decides performance selection. Mean HR@10 was 0.559 for the candidate, 0.56325 for selected_v3, and 0.56725 for the control. The candidate missed its proposed development thresholds, trailing baseline by 0.00425 and control by 0.00825. It exceeded control only in Electronics (+0.005), while the other three category contrasts were negative. These public development results do not establish a causal mechanism or confirmation performance.
unresolved_explanations: The proposed fixed-weight test showing that the candidate gate varies with current state while the control gate stays constant is not supplied; source review and finite synthetic probes do not establish that contrast.

Matching gate parameter shapes, control isolation, and exact trained forward and candidate-scoring equality remain incompletely verified by the supplied checks. Fresh initialization and selected-checkpoint causal, padding, finite-output, and tail-readout probes were audited.

Residual scaling or added parameters, different optimization of static and dynamic gates, sampling, and public-validation checkpoint choice remain competing explanations. No confirmation-seed outcomes are supplied.
